summary_1line: Ravana defeats the Yaksha forces, overpowers Kubera (Dhanada), and seizes the celestial aerial chariot Pushpaka after a fierce magical battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana whirls a massive mace and smashes it onto Kubera’s head, the Lord of Wealth collapsing bloodied like a severed Ashoka tree.
In battle Ravana shifts forms—tiger, boar, cloud, mountain and ocean—confusing Kubera as the armies clash around them.
Victorious Ravana claims the radiant Pushpaka chariot, glittering with gold pillars, emerald doors, and pearl garlands as it hovers in the sky.
